formulas.ascii: Length/perimeter component: L[f] = sum over feature edges e of d(p[e],p[e+1]), using compensated f32 sums. Lines are open; polygon rings close implicitly, including hole perimeters; points have no edges. d is Euclidean, spherical central-angle distance, or capped Vincenty inverse with Lambert reduced-latitude fallback, as selected by spatialContext. Area and centroid use separate model-specific kernels.
